_comment: The only per-repo file in this skill. SKILL.md and repos.md are identical
across every repo that uses /ai-dev — when you copy the skill to another
project, edit this file and nothing else.
'toolkit' is the shared UI library this repo consumes from sources via a
relative path. Set it to null in a repo that has no such dependency.
runInstructions: Both variables are isolation, not decoration. The script refuses a port that is
already in use, and without LUNICLE_LOCAL_DATA every worktree shares ~/.lunicle/ —
where a worktree carrying a newer migration poisons the database for the others.
Browse http://127.0.0.1:{port}/ — NOT localhost. A stale HttpOnly cookie on the
localhost host makes sign-in impossible to script. Sign in by setting
document.cookie = "lunicle_session=<id>; path=/" from a row in the sessions table.
Never run the real OAuth flow.
For a pure-frontend change ./scripts/run-demo.sh --no-open (then ?demo=1) is much
faster — no JVM, no database, no sign-in. After an edit, rebuild
